subject.title: iOS/WebChat messages append to transcript but do not trigger/deliver assistant replies

question: Should maintainers first run a live current-main native iOS/WebChat repro before queueing code work for this issue, or is the existing field evidence enough to choose a fix boundary now?
rationale: The issue has strong field evidence, but current source still shows the intended happy path and related reply-init/restart issues only partially overlap, so automation cannot safely choose the failing boundary without live proof or maintainer scoping.

options.title: Run live native repro first
options.body: Validate iOS app and browser WebChat on the same current-main or beta gateway, comparing `chat.send`, `agent.wait`, raw transcript, and Gateway dispatch logs before assigning a fix path.

options.title: Queue from field evidence
options.body: Proceed with a focused investigation PR from the reported logs, accepting higher risk that the patch may target the wrong boundary.

options.title: Route to overlap issues
options.body: Treat this as covered by reply-init/package or restart-recovery trackers, which risks losing the native iOS-specific ingress evidence preserved here.

recommendation.title: Run live native repro first
recommendation.body: Validate iOS app and browser WebChat on the same current-main or beta gateway, comparing `chat.send`, `agent.wait`, raw transcript, and Gateway dispatch logs before assigning a fix path.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete is the live assignee and has adjacent WebChat/source-reply history, making him the best available owner for the proof-sufficiency choice.
